message.content:
An illustration for the cover of a weekly news magazine features a medium shot of a man centered against a red-toned, textured background. The man has brown skin, dark eyes, and a focused expression. He wears a red beret with an emblem and a camouflage military uniform with a nametag reading "RPKAD" and several silver pins. His hands are at his sides.

Large white text at the top reads "DI BALIK KISRUH KONTES KOMODO" above the word "TEMPO" in a large serif font. Below "TEMPO" is "EDISI 7-13 November 2011". A yellow circle on the left contains black text: "MORATORIUM REMISI BUAT KORUPTOR". Near the bottom, white text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS SARWO EDHIE WIBOWO DAN MISTERI 1965." The letter "O" in "SARWO" and "EDHIE" contains a white eagle emblem and a small red sickle and hammer icon. Fine text at the bottom includes a barcode, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "Rp 27.000." Vertical text on the left edge reads "ISSN: 0126-4273" and "HTTP://WWW.TEMPOINTERAKTIF.COM".
